register: # ADDRESS SHIFT: the register column holds the Modbus PDU (wire) address, which is the vendor's printed register number minus 1 (SunSpec and Fronius number registers from 1, so the SunSpec marker 'SunS' is register 40001 and is read at address 40000). The rows in this file were shifted by -1 for that reason. To compare a row with the vendor document, add 1 to its register (for example Fronius lists total AC power as 40092 and it is read at 40091).

# CORRECTED, NOT JUST SHIFTED: the float inverter model has four temperature floats (cabinet, heat sink, transformer, other) but the original map defined one, so operating_state, vendor_state, alarm_1 and alarm_2 were 6 registers too low. They now use the SunSpec model 113 positions (St 40117, StVnd 40118, Evt1 40119, Evt2 40121). options, version and serial_number were also corrected to the SunSpec common-model fields Opt (40036), Vr (40044) and SN (40052): the original had them rotated by one field. These corrections come from the SunSpec standard, not from Fronius documentation.

# SCALING: the float models need no scale factors; the two nameplate ratings (rated_power, rated_va) are integers with a scale factor and now carry a Context adjustment that reads it (10**SF), so they publish in W and VA. Writable rows are not scaled.
